inputs.note: reproducible_flag=True is the ONLY path clustering.py's node_embedding() call uses (it never passes reproducible_flag=False); this end-to-end fixture targets node_embedding_epoch_repr exclusively, called once per epoch in a python for-loop (see node_embedding()'s source). Because initial_embedding is provided, node_embedding does NOT draw its own normal() init -- the FIRST RandomState draw is rng_val = random_state.randint(INT32_MAX, size=n_epochs), done ONCE up front, before the epoch loop. Inside the loop, epoch n's rng_state argument to node_embedding_epoch_repr is np.uint32(rng_val[n]) -- a single scalar per epoch, reused for every negative-sample draw within that epoch (see the single-epoch fixture note for the index arithmetic; there is no tau_rand advancing state anywhere in node_embedding). AFTER each epoch's node_embedding_epoch_repr call: `updates *= (1.0 - alpha) ** 2 * 0.5` (updates array persists/decays across epochs, it is NOT re-zeroed), then `random_state.shuffle(node_order)` (one shuffle per epoch, recorded in order in node_order_shuffles -- node_order starts as arange(n_vertices) before epoch 0 and is permuted in place by each shuffle), then `alpha = initial_alpha * (1 - n / n_epochs)` for the NEXT epoch (note: alpha for epoch n uses the value computed after epoch n-1; epoch 0 uses the raw initial_alpha unchanged). gamma_schedule = np.linspace(0.5, 1.5, n_epochs) (deterministic, no RNG; gamma_schedule[n] is epoch n's gamma argument -- recompute it, not recorded separately here). csr_indptr/csr_indices passed to the kernel are graph.indptr/graph.indices cast to uint32 (reconstruct from indptr/indices above). Determinism was verified: an independent RandomState(303) replay of the WHOLE function reproduces final_embedding bit-for-bit. Python tolerance is loose (fastmath accumulation over 10 epochs) but Rust and Zig MUST match each other bit-for-bit per PORTING.md.
